rationale: PCRX has gapped up 44% on no news context available, with price already sitting at the session low after only 3 minutes of trading, showing a clear downward drift from the open (36.33 → 36.28) on massive relative volume (112x). The ATR is tiny ($0.12) relative to the gap magnitude, making stop placement extremely difficult — a short risks a squeeze continuation while a long risks being caught in a gap fade with no clear support structure below. Without knowing the catalyst and with price already compressing at the low of a 5-cent range, the risk/reward is undefined in both directions.
